name: get_events
description: Retrieve events from GSFC'S EONET natural event tracker. Use this to query live natural events and inject them into user chats. Available event categories are: 'drought', 'dustHaze', 'earthquakes', 'floods', 'landslides', 'manmade', 'seaLakeIce', 'severeStorms', 'snow', 'tempExtremes', 'volcanoes', 'waterColor', and 'wildfires'.

global_search.description: Search for events across all categories, limiting to 5 results. Note: `None` strings are used to represent python `None` value.

targeted_search.description: Search for events within the `wildfires` category, limiting to 5 results. Note: `None` strings are used to represent python `None` value.
